name: Dwellers In Angles
source:
Darren is a daring teen who practices astral projection. When he decides to venture further than he's ever been, something unimaginable is waiting for him. 

[From [url=https://nightfable.itch.io/dwellers-in-angles]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
达伦是一个大胆的青少年，他练习星体投射。当他决定比以往更进一步冒险时，一些难以想象的事情正在等待着他。

[来自[url=https://nightfable.itch.io/dwellers-in-angles]Itch.io[/url]]
